title: The Hunter's Moon Holds Its Own Beauty

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Well this is rare. Out of everyone
at training camp, I'm the
first one up and
about.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(As if... It's not like I planned to get up
early. I just couldn't sleep.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I should run a little.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I'm looking forward to seeing your
beautiful dance." "She's so
stunning, her
visuals are insane!" "Please post lots of
pictures of your
costume!" Hm...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I thought so. So that's why I was chosen,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...To be a pretty face?

text_block_list.name: Dance Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... No, never mind. You're doing great
just as you are!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Really? Well, as long as it's pretty, that's
all that matters.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
And with that, I think I've done a good job
of playing my role.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What do you mean, your role?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Like, my part? I think I was chosen as a
mascot this time around. My
image doesn't
exactly shout "history" or "tradition" or
anything,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So I thought I'd do what I do best and
make sure this festival goes
viral. I'm
serious about the dance, though. I wanna
surprise people
with that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Or at least, that's what I thought would be
cutest! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: AAAAAGH! Damn, I'm such a loser!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(I'm so over being judged by my looks. But
all I do is sulk about it.)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(Should I accept it, like Curren, and just
play out my role properly? Is
that how I'll
become my own person and not just a
pretty face?)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
(No, that can't be it. Curren is Curren.
What works for her isn't gonna
work for
me...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hup! Doo-doo-doo! Then like this!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh, City! Good morn'n! Um, were
you doin' some practice?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well, something like that. What
about you? Practicing the
dance on your
own?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Yeah. I'm no good at danc'n
c'mpared to you two, and I'm in
the middle
for th'best part...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
So at the very least, I just don't want to
stand out for th'wrong reason
and ruin it
for you—oh my gosh!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you okay? It's too early to be
pushing yourself this much.
Besides, I've
never once thought you would ruin it or
anything like
that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I know, let's go rinse off together. I'm
all sweaty too, and the
day hasn't even
started.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow! It's so thick and fluffy-wuffy, I almost can't believe this is my tail! What a treat, hav'n you wash my tail! Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I just have a few tricks up my sleeve from
experience, that's all. The
oil and
conditioner did the rest.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
The only reason those tricks worked was
because your tail was already
in good
condition. That goes for your hair and skin
too.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and your dance, too. I think you
should believe in yourself more,
Yukino!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City... Hehe! Thank oodles.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But still, it's an import'nt festival
p'formance. I've gotta work harder so
I
don't look like a chowderhead up there!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I guess it is important...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Do you like festivals, Yukino?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm? Um... Yeah, I s'pose I do.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
We have an autumn fest'val in my
hometown too, to celebrate the
harvest.
It's real small c'mpared to the Fleetfoot
Festival or the one
we went to yesterday,
though.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But it's still a roar'n good time! Food stalls
sell the freshly picked
veggies, and we all
eat, dance by the fire, and sing the
rice-plant'n
song together.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
When wint'r comes, ev'thing gets covered
in snow and it goes quiet...
But when I
think of the fun of the festival, it perks me
right back up!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I see... So that's what festivals mean to
you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah... What do they mean to you, City?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: What do they mean...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hey! So this is where you two were!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You went for bath time without
me? That's so mean! We're the
ceremonial
dance trio!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah?! Gee, I'm sorry! We didn't mean to
leave you out!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Apology not accepted! ☆ If you're really sorry... Come to the outdoor bath with me so we can all chat and bathe together! ☆

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: C'mon, c'mon! Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: (Curren is Curren. Yukino is Yukino...)

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Then... what about me?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Um, President! Could I talk to you for a
minute please?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, Gold City. What is it?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You had some documents about the
Fleetfoot Festival, right? Could
I... see
them, please?
